about: R134a (HFC-134a) is a non-ozone-depleting refrigerant used in car air conditioning, domestic and commercial refrigerators, water coolers and some chillers. It is non-flammable and works at medium pressure.
It is not a drop-in for R12 or R22 systems without checking oil and component compatibility. Use the correct manifold gauges and oil for the system.

faq.question: Is R134A (Tetrafluoroethane) flammable?
faq.answer: R134A (Tetrafluoroethane) is classified as non-flammable, but it is stored under pressure and can displace oxygen in enclosed spaces. Handle it through a trained technician with proper gauges, recovery equipment and ventilation.
